description: An original charming masculine cafe companion voice. Soft warm light tenor with a friendly audible smile and rounded mellow resonance. Gently playful, affectionate, cozy, lightly lilting short phrases, relaxed easy articulation. A sweet encouraging companion talking quietly beside you. No whispering, no deep announcer delivery, no singing.
text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
